quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 Let me repeat 和 central 强化的重复重点

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在主旨听力中抓住说话人反复强化的核心观点，而不是被铺垫句或例子带偏。

major_issues: Existing flip card asks for a repeated key point but hides the checkable answer on the back.
The analysis is template-heavy and does not teach how Let me repeat and This point is central mark the repeated emphasis.
No quality_metadata is present, so source/audio and review status are not explicit.
minor_issues: Audio file quality is not formally reviewed; current review only covers text/task design.
cards.recommendation: Rewrite as an auto-scored multiple_choice card that tests the repeated data-sharing point.

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 用 again/stress 信号识别持续反馈这一重复重点

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户把多次改写的同一观点合并为主旨，减少被单一细节词误导。

major_issues: Existing multiple_choice answer direction is usable, but the analysis is template-heavy and does not explain regular feedback / steady feedback loop as repeated emphasis.
The back text overstates the repetition pattern compared with the transcript and should be made text-faithful.
The card lacks quality_metadata, leaving simulated source and TTS boundaries implicit.
minor_issues: Keep the core answer direction but rewrite prompt, options, analysis, and metadata for sample review.
cards.recommendation: Retain the transcript and answer direction, but make the repeated-feedback rule explicit.

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 Once more 重复强调的 service consistency 主旨

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在让步转折后继续捕捉重复强调点，完整保留主旨对象和作用。

major_issues: Existing timing-click task is downcast to flip, so the front promises click behavior that is not exposed by the product contract here.
The answer-window back side cannot serve as a self-contained front-side learning task.
The card should test the repeated service-consistency point after Once more rather than unreviewed timing-window behavior.
minor_issues: Original time_window_ms is unsuitable for this candidate sample branch because audio timing has not been formally reviewed.
cards.recommendation: Rewrite as multiple_choice to separate cost-control setup from the repeated consistency point.

batch_review.box_progression: The existing first three cards do not yet form a clean recognition -> application -> transfer progression for 重复重点.
repetition_or_gap_risks: Two cards depend on back-side or timing-window answer revelation rather than front-side solvable choices.
Source and TTS status are not explicit in quality_metadata.
batch_review.next_step: Revise only the first three cards as a candidate sample and keep it out of approved_batches until explicit user confirmation.
